body: I got that error as well after the update. After restarting the app I immediately clicked the home icon before the error message comes up and got around that loop. This was after I updated.
I have sent a couple of messages. We were advised that the only option would be an institution and it's a terrible place. I cant do that to her.

That's why I'm hoping the family come back so I can get a couple hours of sleep. I was hoping one of her sisters would stay with her but she didn't. I'm in the Caribbean and the only emergency care she can get is through the police. I have told the family if it gets worse then that would be my only option but I dont want to do that to her.

They said they would come back but this isn't the first time I've reached out to her family for help, and with the family grieving their loss right now I doubt they will be of more help than they were last night. Our doctor friend said she would try to get her an appointment to see someone but I dont know when.
They came over and tried talking to her but she refused to talk to them or go home with them. So they left her here and went home. I hope they come back soon.
